history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: this CSV row (seq 2430, 'Kunjapuri Devi Temple, Rishikesh') is the same record as seq 1120 (id kunjapuri-temple-narendra-nagar) - the Kunjapuri hill Shakti Peetha. This file is intentionally thin; the authoritative record is 1120. CSV TOWN FLAG: the temple is NOT in Rishikesh town - it stands atop the 1,676-metre Kunjapuri hill near Narendra Nagar in Tehri Garhwal district, about 7 km from Narendra Nagar and 25-27 km by road from Rishikesh. It is one of the Siddha Peethas / Shakti Peethas of Uttarakhand (tradition says the chest of the goddess Sati fell here) and forms a sacred triangle with the Surkanda Devi and Chandrabadani temples; it is a famous sunrise viewpoint over the Garhwal Himalayan peaks and the Doon Valley.

name: Kunjapuri Devi Temple
town: Kunjapuri hill (near Narendra Nagar; CSV town 'Rishikesh' is approximate)
town_description: Kunjapuri is a 1,676-m hill near Narendra Nagar in Tehri Garhwal, about 7 km from Narendra Nagar and 25-27 km by road from Rishikesh - the shrine is a renowned sunrise viewpoint over the Garhwal Himalaya and Doon Valley.

travel.railway: Rishikesh Railway Station (approx. 25-27 km by road)
travel.road: About 25-27 km from Rishikesh (approx. 1 hour) and 7 km from Narendra Nagar; reachable by taxi, plus an 80-300 step climb (accounts vary) from the road to the shrine

visitor_information.best_time: March to June and September to November for clear skies and sunrise views; Navratri (April/October) for the major celebrations. Avoid July-August monsoon rains.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sources conflict: 5:00 AM-6:00 PM, 5:00 AM-7:00 PM, and 6:00 AM-8:00 PM are all cited (verify locally). No entry fee.
